relationship between MRI and outcomes in 756 women
undergoing BCS and radiation from 1992 to 2001. Eight-
year local failure rates were 3 % in the MRI group and 4 %
in the no-MRI group (p = 0.51). For the small subset of
patients with DCIS, 8-year rates of LRR were 6 % both
with (n = 31) and without (n = 105) MRI. They found no
difference in survival or CBC rates.
